versions.changelog:
- Added hint_allow_substrings to improve discoverability (e.g., "orf", "orf.at", "österreich news").
- No functional or logic changes to the code or content structure.
- Version remains structurally and functionally identical; this update is metadata-only.

Initial release: strictly structured ORF News headlines from official RSS feeds.

- Fetches and parses official ORF Nachrichten (news), Sport, and Science feeds with strict host-to-section mapping.
- In "overview" scenarios, displays 3 news, 1 sport, and 1 science headline—never mixing or duplicating stories across sections.
- RSS/RDF format handling for different feeds (news/sport: RSS1.0, science: RSS2.0).
- Output uses clean, sectioned Markdown layout with exact title/link pairs from the feeds.
- Enforces precise placement, no headline or URL invention, and clear formatting for all responses.
